تجتذبوا (form VIII)
# تَجْتَذِبُوا (tajtaḏibū) /tad͡ʒ.ta.ði.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
# تُجْتَذَبُوا (tujtaḏabū) /tud͡ʒ.ta.ða.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
